subject.title: [Bug]: Agent self-update bypasses update.run and uses raw npm global upgrade without restarting gateway

question: Should maintainers repair and land the linked exec-control guard PR, replace it with a fresh shared-guard fix, or choose a different self-update enforcement boundary?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-protected and paired with an open conflicting PR, so automation should not queue a new repair lane without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair or replace linked PR
options.body: Move the guard into the shared exec-control boundary, cover both exec consumers, and require proof before closing the issue.

options.title: Choose a different boundary
options.body: Define a different product policy such as allowing raw installs only when followed by an enforced restart or diagnostic handoff.

options.title: Fold into broader stale-runtime work
options.body: Keep this issue linked while a broader update/rollback stale-module policy owns the remaining behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace linked PR
recommendation.body: Move the guard into the shared exec-control boundary, cover both exec consumers, and require proof before closing the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main routing candidate for the shared exec-control guard boundary.
